_comment: RANGE-REGIME (ADX) filter calibration. Forces UseRegime=1; enter only when ADX < ADXMax (low-trend / range regime, where mean-reversion works best). ADXPeriod must be >0 or the gate blocks everything. Run only if the screen kept UseRegime ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SFIN -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/sfin/reversion_cal_regime.json -out ./reports/SFIN_regime -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
